Creeps and Curses V.3.1

Special Trait. Please note that these abilities are incredibly powerful even for the JJK system and should only be used for purposely high power games. Of course, certain traits are stronger than others. Stages of these traits have been added to grow with characters with higher levels of play. Dormant, Stirring, and Awakened. Though a DM can decide to change the leveling format or instead give them out at appropriate character moments.

Bizarrely Sturdy. Your hit point maximum increases by 4 times your level and increases by 4 every time you gain a level. Your walking speed increases to 40 ft unless it is higher already and you can take the Dash action as a bonus action. (This replaces Oddly Sturdy)

Powerful Body. Your Strength, Dexterity, and Constitution scores increase by 2 again and your maximum for those scores is 24. Additionally, you have resistance to poison damage and immunity to the poisoned condition.

Ultimate Prison. You gain a bonus to ability checks or saving throws against being taken over by your proficiency bonus + your Constitution modifier. Additionally, you increase the DCs a cursed object or reincarnated sorcerer makes to take over your body by your proficiency bonus + your Constitution modifier. This includes methods of possession.

Special Trait tiers stack: keep the earlier tiers on the sheet. When a benefit says it replaces an earlier one, the module's effects already account for it.
